description: Inventory all non-Git persisted data across scenarios and resources. Classify each surface as canonical, legacy, exempt, or disposable; identify which data is already discoverable from api-core/storage or RESOURCE_*_DIR; and produce an exact migration list for the holdouts. Explicitly exclude browser-only storage such as localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB from the backup target set.
name: platform-persistence-surface-audit
title: Audit the platform persistence surface across scenarios and resources
